title: SPR Runway Breaks Before Midterms — Oil Shock as Regime Fatality
statement: The regime is running the US Strategic Petroleum Reserve down to the bone (~290M barrel cavern-damage floor, no refill capacity while at war) while papering over the Hormuz supply collapse with a 'stolen Venezuelan oil' narrative that cannot physically flow fast enough. A breakable oil shock will land BEFORE the November midterms — driven by either SPR breaching the ~290M floor, a major convoy/tanker loss, or a Bab el-Mandeb closure — and it may be the regime's fatality, not merely its electoral loss.
evidence_confirmed: SPR fell below 300M barrels (lowest since 1983); ~293M as of Aug 14, ~41% of 714M capacity
SPR drain rate ~3.7-6.1M bbl/week with no refill capability during wartime
Hormuz transits collapsed ~88-95% from baseline (~100+/day pre-war to single/low-double digits; Windward logged 10 on Aug 30, Kpler 7 worst-day, PortWatch 3 on Aug 23)
Normalized flow (~10M bpd claim) weighted toward Iran's sanctioned AIS-dark supertankers, not American-consumer supply
Venezuela '65B barrel partnership' is a claim on reserves, not a physical supply line — narrative prop buying time
US net import shortfall ~6.8M bpd; SPR alone covers only ~1.4 months if imports fully cut
CNBC experts flag cavern-damage operational risk below ~290M barrels
Houthis formally entered the war threatening Bab el-Mandeb; ~15.5% closure odds priced (now trending)
US struck Iran's Larak Island Aug 30 — agitation cycle ticking back up

Sept 1, 2026: Adoption of 'tanker for tanker' active bombing campaign against Iranian state tankers directly threatens the fragile, remaining crude flow through Hormuz, severely compounding the risk of an oil shock before midterms.

Midterm clock (Nov 3, 2026, 61 days out): 172M bbl SPR release + 400M multinational coordinated release confirmed; SPR below half capacity and draining faster than any prior admin. The release is explicitly timed to hold gas prices through Election Day -- the reserve IS the runway to Nov 3.

2026-09-09: Trump publicly states Iran war will end right after midterms (Reuters) — principal concedes the electoral runway is the binding constraint; corroborates runway-breaks-before-midterms mechanism from the top
Sept 11: Brent >$101/WTI >$96 sustained — highest since July; diesel $5.94; ten tankers destroyed past week per CENTCOM; war in month seven

2026-09-16 (Chevron CEO Mike Wirth, per WSJ): fuel crisis oil executives warned of has 'officially arrived'; mitigation buffers 'largely now played out'; system holding nowhere near war-start buffers - CORROBORATES the buffer-depletion mechanism of this prediction from the sector's largest US producer, corporate tier. Wirth has not spoken to Trump since Aug 3 ('DOWN, NOW!' demand). Also 9/16: Fed hiked 25bps into depleting-buffer system (stagflation config); Saudi east-west pipeline outage (4% global supply threat, 9/15) compounds; House adjourned until after midterms with gas-tax fix dead.

[2026-09-17] Crude ~$102 (+21.5% mo, +61% y/y); US distillate inventories forecast below 100M bbl through YE2026 (EIA STEO Sept); United cutting December flights on fuel cost; American adding ~$ per-gallon surcharge — consumer tier reached

2026-09-18 (EIA weekly, via TKL): SPR -403k to 285.4M bbl — lowest since Nov 1982; 25th straight weekly decline; -131M/-46% since 2021-23; commercial crude ex-SPR 423.4M, lowest since ~2014. The ~290M cavern-damage floor trigger leg is now breached — prediction's primary trigger satisfied with 7 weeks to Election Day.

Prediction markets still see Bab el-Mandeb closure as minority event
